alt_text: Route and weather context covers canonical event distances in miles and available temperature in degrees Fahrenheit and wind in miles per hour; missing weather is not filled.
interpretation: Route and weather help contextualize observed mobility events; unavailable weather remains missing and no route geometry is inferred.
limitations: Sample counts, date coverage, source scope, missingness, and measurement availability accompany each scientific result.
long_description: Route and weather help contextualize observed mobility events; unavailable weather remains missing and no route geometry is inferred. Canonical physical distance is miles; weather temperature is °F and wind is mph. Weather-unavailable events remain explicit and are not estimated. Sample counts, date coverage, source scope, missingness, and measurement availability accompany each scientific result.
qualifications: Canonical physical distance is miles; weather temperature is °F and wind is mph.
Weather-unavailable events remain explicit and are not estimated.
